suread: review R1 素读（只读 text/，未开 md）

facts.fact: 达特冒雨来到亨利家时，弗吉尼亚姨婆穿着黄色雨衣和配套的人字拖在自家车道上喊住她。
facts.anchor: Aunt Virginia stood in her driveway, wearing a yellow raincoat and matching flip-flops.

facts.fact: 弗吉尼亚姨婆好奇地看了一眼利昂舅公的文件并提出帮忙拿，但达特拒绝了，把它们抱得更紧。
facts.anchor: She gave Uncle Leon’s papers a curious glance and offered to take them, but I refused, clutching them tighter

facts.fact: 亨利斜倚在皮沙发上，编着盒式辫子，手里晃着一杯鸡尾酒，优雅地举杯致意。
facts.anchor: Henri reclined on a leather couch, her box braids draped loosely over her shoulder, a cocktail glass dangling

facts.fact: 亨利说飓风弗洛拉又升级了，达到二级，即将重创奥卡拉，她还归咎于全球变暖。
facts.anchor: “You hear she’s been upgraded again? Cat Two, if you can believe it. About to tear up Ocala.

facts.fact: 亨利说如果弗洛拉的路径不变，再有大约四小时风暴就会抵达他们这里。
facts.anchor: Should be four hours before Flora hits us, if her course holds true.

facts.fact: 弗吉尼亚姨婆低声向达特道歉，达特认为她在为把自己丢在格里尔宅、没提醒她加齐的事道歉。
facts.anchor: “I’m sorry,” she whispered.

facts.fact: 弗吉尼亚姨婆讲述伊达对加齐极为残酷：她曾撞见伊达把靴子踩在加齐头上，把她的脸往地上碾，此后加齐常头痛。
facts.anchor: Ida had placed her boot on Gazzie’s head and was grinding her face into the ground.

facts.fact: 莱昂想去上大学，卡罗琳认为他背叛家族，加齐在一場学费争吵后罚他在农场过夜。
facts.anchor: After another fight about college tuition, Gazzie made Leon stay overnight on the farm as punishment.

facts.fact: 弗吉尼亚姨婆自责当时劝莱昂再试一次农场工作，说没想到他会真的上手，因为他一直讨厌农场。
facts.anchor: I told him he might actually enjoy the work. That he should give it one last shot.

facts.fact: 加齐独自回家时下巴上有一点血迹，还让弗吉尼亚烧掉衣服、在警察问起时谎称她整晚都和自己在一起。
facts.anchor: Told me to burn her clothes and say she’d been with me all evening if the police asked.

facts.fact: 两小时后卡罗琳怒气冲冲地闯进来，说加齐是个怪物，说她打了利昂、他摔倒时头撞在石头上。
facts.anchor: Said Gazzie was a monster, that she’d struck Leon, that he’d fallen and hit his head on a stone.

facts.fact: 加齐确认利昂没有脉搏后，把他滚进水里并用赶畜棒激怒鳄鱼，让鳄鱼拖走尸体、掩盖伤情、伪装成意外。
facts.anchor: she rolled him into the water and grabbed a prod. Riled up a gator so it’d drag the body in, hide his injuries

facts.fact: 卡罗琳当晚宣布永不再见家人，说自己想离开，为的是给她的孩子一个机会。
facts.anchor: “She said she wanted to give her child a chance.”

facts.fact: 达特得知父母从未结婚，母亲改姓格里尔只是因为恨格雷家，自己的名字其实不属于自己。
facts.anchor: Mama hated the Greers so much she’d changed her last name to his even though they hadn’t been married

facts.fact: 卡罗琳说格里尔家的血脉被伊达的血玷污了，她想离开好让孩子有机会做个好人。
facts.anchor: She said the Greer line was tainted by Ida’s blood.

facts.fact: 达特崩溃地承认自己害死了妈妈，说这话像石头一样从嘴里掉下来。
facts.anchor: “I killed Mama, too,” I said, the words falling like stones from my lips.

facts.fact: 达特回想一小时前自己朝哈里森摔了玻璃杯、还用赶畜棒扫过他的脸，觉得妈妈会为此羞耻。
facts.anchor: I couldn’t imagine her reaction to me swiping the cattle prod across his face.

facts.fact: 达特告诉弗吉尼亚是哈里森让她来问加齐做了什么，并说哈里森是农场破坏事件的幕后黑手，已经招供。
facts.anchor: “Harrison told me to ask what Gazzie did,” I said, relishing the shocked expression spreading across her face.

facts.fact: 达特把利昂的记录塞进门口的报纸塑料袋里、抽走报纸，不带伞冲进雨中离开。
facts.anchor: I grabbed it, pulled out the newspaper, and replaced it with Uncle Leon’s records.

facts.fact: 章末达特走到老火车站旁的海堤边，迎着像刀子一样飞来的雨滴仰起脸。
facts.anchor: I tipped my face toward the raindrops that flew at me like knives.
